scope: Actual saved PNG sheets inspected with local image viewer after source thumbnails were corrected to fit their columns. This is visual QA of the pixels shown, not a browser, Windows, phone or installer review.
observations: All columns have legible recipe labels, identical source crop coordinates and non-overlapping overview thumbnails. Victor and Mukai amounts0/25/50/100 atR1/T3 look intentionally very similar, without obvious bright edge fringes or flattened skin at displayed1:1 crops.

Aggressive100/R3/T0 makes seeded gray noise visibly coarser and Mukai eye/skin microtexture slightly harsher. This is a negative control, not a recommendation for portraits. Positive threshold12 suppresses this synthetic low-level noise but is not an adaptive denoiser.

The softened edge gets a restrained contrast increase without black/white ringing in the displayed strip; numerical local-luminance and quantization-envelope tests provide the stronger bound evidence.
No restored source pixel file or provenance file was modified. NASA attribution and private/informational-only restrictions are retained in sheets and README.
qualification: Visual inspection is subjective and limited to these samples and display crops. It does not establish broad quality superiority or restoration of missing detail.
